rules.detects: an exported const created by createServerFn (TanStack Start)
an exported const created by calling a symbol a declared entrance names as its handler or guard
an exported route created by createFileRoute with server handlers, createServerFileRoute or createAPIFileRoute

a GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS a Next.js app/**/route file exports, declared there, in an export list or re-export, or destructured; a default export under pages/api; or an exported loader or action under app/routes
the proxy a Next.js proxy.ts exports, or the middleware a middleware.ts exports, at the root or under src/: declared, in an export list or re-export, or as the default export
the default export of a Next.js app/**/page file, the page as a whole
an exported function of a file that opens with 'use server'
an object literal naming a path or pattern that starts with / and a handler, on one line
a call like app.get('/path', handler) whose first argument is a path starting with /
a project file a package.json script runs with node, tsx, ts-node, bun, deno, vite-node or python
a file directly under a top-level scripts/ or bin/ folder that no project file imports

entrances.notDetected: file routes outside a Next.js app/**/page without server handlers (their work enters through server functions), hand-written dispatchers, message consumers, workers and host callbacks are not detected

ladder.because: a symbol not exported from its module cannot be referenced from another module; the compiler refuses it

rungs.fact: the protected thing is not exported from its module, so no other module can reference it

rungs.enforcer: Coherence's check at the edit and in CI
rungs.fact: the protected thing is exported, and every resolved reference in the project is inside the chokepoint
